title: Integrate term by term
text: Find an antiderivative of each term separately, then add the constant of integration C.

title: Integrate each exponential
text: An antiderivative of $$e^{k x}$$ is $$\frac{e^{k x}}{k}$$. So $$e^{2x}$$ gives $$\frac{e^{2x}}{2}$$, and $$\frac{1}{2} e^{\frac{x}{2}}$$ gives $$2\frac{1}{2} e^{\frac{x}{2}}=e^{\frac{x}{2}}$$.
